page.layout: One page of text; running head across top; marginal notes in left margin (three lines of a note beside the paragraph); catchword "Ec-" at lower right.

main_text.p: mines, ita quisquis est, qui solus Sacerdos appellari appetit, super cæteros Sacerdotes se extollit.

Vaticinium Gregorii M. de sequentibus temporibus.XXXV. Sunt hæc Gregorii Pontificis verè Χαλεπα ῥήματα. Majus tamen illud est, quòd idem Gregorius proximè futuram tempestatem, tanquam ex specula quapiam ante prospiciens, de sequentibus temporibus ita lib. VIII. Ep. 36. vaticinatur: Qui post nos vixerint, deteriora tempora videbunt, ita ut in comparatione sui temporis felices nos æstiment dies habuisse. Alibi lib. IV. Epist. 38. expressius: Omnia quæ prædicta sunt, fiunt. Rex superbiæ prope est, & (quod dici nefas est) Sacerdotum est præparatus exercitus.

page.notes: The Greek words in the opening of XXXV are printed in Greek letters; the transcription of them is approximate. The marginal note at left is set in italic, three-line block: "Vaticinium Gregorii M. de sequentibus temporibus." The note's hyphenated words are rendered as one phrase.
